title: BatteryLog Analysis Result v9
description: Opt-in failure-model evidence. Legacy-only results retain the frozen result-v8 contract. Structural validation is supplemented by validate_result_semantics.

rows_input.description: Total source data rows. Semantically equals rows_analyzed plus rows_excluded.

rows_analyzed.description: Source rows included in engineering-rule evaluation and extrema.

rows_excluded.description: Source rows excluded because at least one required value was invalid.

sample_count.description: Number of violating analyzed samples represented by the event.

duration_s.description: Elapsed timestamp span from event start to event end; a single-sample event may have zero duration.

peak_excursion.description: Non-negative absolute threshold distance at the event peak, in the event unit.

start_row.description: 1-based first source data row in the event; semantic validation also requires start_row <= end_row <= rows_input.

end_row.description: 1-based last source data row in the event; semantic validation also requires start_row <= end_row <= rows_input.

affected_values.description: Number of invalid values represented by the event; semantically equals the inclusive row span multiplied by the signal count.
